_meta.description: Facet of income on the customers aged 50 and over (FILTER_RANGE on age; numeric arm with a 20-bin histogram and percentiles) decorated with an OVERLAY_KS_VS_POP scalar overlay: a two-sample Kolmogorov-Smirnov test of the subset's income distribution against the whole cohort's, D = max |F_subset - F_pop| with the asymptotic p TEST_KS reports for the same D and n (D about 0.05, p about 1.0 here: older customers earn like everyone else). Both distribution functions are rebuilt from the histograms, else from the percentiles, so set include_histogram or numeric_percentiles; with neither, or an empty side, the layer reads null with PULSE_OVERLAY_REF_ZERO. ref.population.cohort names the comparison cohort as a path resolved from the working directory (it takes no data_dir, so run from the repo root). Numeric fields only; OVERLAY_CHISQ_VS_POP (18_facet_chisq_vs_pop.json) serves a discrete one. Buffered.
_meta.name: facet-ks-vs-pop
